descriptionHtml:
What this page helps you compare

This is the selection page for the SAMAN container cafe range. It carries the currently published size options with the currently published price table, links the technical specification PDF, and points to the approved specialist formats — so you can settle two decisions in order: which format fits your business, then which published size fits your plot. Your order itself is confirmed through an itemised quotation.

Using the published size and price table

The selector above shows the currently published size options, each with its currently published price. Treat the published figure as the starting point for a like-for-like comparison, not the whole answer: ask the quotation to confirm what the figure for your size contains, what is quoted separately, and how tax is shown — line by line, in writing — before you compare it against any other supplier's number.

The approved specialist formats

Five approved specialist pages sit alongside this one. If your plan matches one of them, read it before you settle here:

  • Explore Container Coffee Shop
  • Explore Container Restaurant
  • Explore Food Truck Containers
  • Explore Modular Container Cafe
  • Explore Container Hotel

Choose this page when what you want is the general cafe unit from the published range.

What to ask before you order: a buyer checklist

A container cafe is a food-service building, and most of what decides whether it works at your site is settled in the quotation stage. Put these questions in writing:

  • Kitchen scope. Ask the quotation to confirm which kitchen provisions, if any, are included for your size, and which are quoted separately.
  • Equipment. Ask for the electrical provision to be confirmed against your actual appliance list rather than assumed.
  • Power. Ask for the supply your menu needs and the provision the unit will carry to be stated side by side.
  • Ventilation and exhaust. Ask what your cooking process requires and what the unit will be fitted with, before fabrication.
  • Water and drainage. Ask where supply and waste connect at your plot, and what the unit's connection points need from your side.
  • Licences and permissions. Ask which food-business and site permissions apply for your municipality and plot, and confirm them before you commit to a delivery position.

Price, delivery and site readiness: questions to settle

Ask the quotation to confirm, as separate written lines: the unit price for your chosen published size; any item beyond the base scope; how transport and unloading will be quoted for your location; any work required on your side of the site; and how tax is shown. Before a delivery date is discussed, ask what the delivery vehicle and unloading method need from your access, what base the unit should stand on, and which utility connection points must be within reach of the unit's position.

Questions buyers ask

Where can I compare the approved Container Cafe formats?

On this page. The five approved specialist formats are linked above — Container Coffee Shop, Container Restaurant, Food Truck Containers, Modular Container Cafe and Container Hotel — and this page carries the published size and price table for the general cafe unit.

What information should I include in a quotation request?

The published size you are considering, your site location, your intended use, and the questions from the checklist above that matter most to your project — kitchen scope, equipment list, power, ventilation, water and drainage, and access for delivery. Asking for the answers as separate written lines makes quotations comparable across suppliers.

Where are the currently published size and price options shown?

In the selector and price table at the top of this page. Each published size shows its currently published price; the itemised quotation then confirms the scope that applies to your order.
